sources.title: CetinLM — Efficient Large Language Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: CetinLM is an independent large language model research and engineering project focused on one practical question: How capable can a modern language model become while remaining small, efficient, and realistically runnable on accessible hardware?

sources.snippet: CetinLM-1B continues training. 🚀 We've now passed 20.5K steps / 167.9M tokens in the current base-model run. 📉 Validation loss: 4.115 📊 Perplexity: 61.26 🧠 Parameters: 1.048B 🎯 Target: 1B training tokens 🖥️ Development target: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16GB We also started checkpoint-based benchmarking so we can measure the model as it learns — not just wait until the end ...

sources.title: CladeTeam/CENO-1B-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CENO-1B-base CENO-1B-base is the base pretraining checkpoint of the 1B CENO DNA foundation model — a causal language model over genomic sequence built on a Nemotron-H Mamba / Attention / Mixture-of-Experts hybrid backbone (no MSA inputs). It is part of the CENO DNA foundation model family.
